# HierAnnot change log

## 0.8.53

- Released June 15th, 2026
- Refined normal hierarchies for selected tissue type: `liver_tme`, `pancreas_tme`, `skin_tme`, `tonsil_tme`.
- Enabled built-ins, parallel scoring and reporting for flat `MaligantProgram` sets.
- Enabled automatic tissue type detection via `detect_tissue_type()` function and special `tissue_origin_screen` shallow built-in hierarchy. 

## 0.7.55 

- Released April 30th, 2026
- Initial release.
